title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: S is a Z-graded commutative ring concentrated in degrees >= 0, with S^0 = k. A marginal note announces generalities on graded modules over arbitrary graded rings. Let M be the category of graded S-modules. The shift T, with T(M)_i = M_{i+1}, is an automorphism of M, and T^n(M)_i = M_{i+n} for n in Z.

The full subcategory M^+ consists of modules concentrated in degrees >= 0. The page notes that T^{-1}(M^+) ⊂ M^+, and more generally T^{-N}(M^+) = M_N, the modules concentrated in degrees >= N. This gives a decreasing filtration of M by full subcategories, M_N ⊃ M_{N'} for N <= N', with M_0 = M^+.

Let N be the category of (ungraded) k-modules. The extension-of-scalars functor φ : N → M, M_0 ↦ M_0 ⊗_k S (placed in degree 0), lands in M^+ because S is non-negatively graded.

Section 1 studies the fully faithful inclusions i_{N,N'} : M_{N'} → M_N for N' >= N. These commute with limits and colimits, which are computed degreewise, so both adjoints should exist. The right adjoint is the truncation τ_{N',N} : M_N → M_{N'}, which keeps M_i for i >= N' and sets it to 0 for i < N'. Because S lives in degrees >= 0, this is an S-submodule of M.

The left adjoint, not yet written on this page, would be M ↦ M / (S·M_{<N'}). These are the standard t-structure-like truncations ('bête' truncations) for graded modules. The page is preliminary bookkeeping, presumably for the graded/filtered algebra behind the divided-power de Rham complex lecture (Koszul-type duality between graded modules and k-modules via φ).
errors: No mathematical errors. The right adjoint τ_{≥N'} is correctly identified as a submodule, using that S is non-negatively graded.
The left adjoint is anticipated but not constructed on this page. It is the quotient by the submodule generated by M_{<N'}, not simply the degreewise truncation.

ideas.what: Shift automorphism of graded modules and the filtration by subcategories of modules in degrees >= N

ideas.what: Right and left adjoints of the inclusion of modules in degrees >= N' into those in degrees >= N, given by truncation τ_{>=N'} (submodule) and quotient by S·M_{<N'}
ideas.modern_name: Graded truncation functors; recollement-type adjunctions for graded modules

deep.surprise_reason: Elementary preliminaries on graded modules (shifts, truncation adjoints). These are standard, with nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'T^n itéré [?]' likely reads 'T^n itéré de T (n ∈ Z)'.
'Commutent aux lim et lim': the two underlined lim are projective and inductive limits, i.e. the inclusions commute with both limits and colimits.
'(pl. f.f.d)' likely abbreviates 'pleinement fidèles' (fully faithful inclusions).
The 'T^{[-N-]-N}' crossing-out is just T^{-N}(M^+) = M_N.
